# One-Click Container Sorting (Pure Client)
First release of the inventory sorting mod.

## Features
- **Pure Client-Side**: Works on servers without server-side installation.
- **Smart Sorting**: Categorized sorting (Tools > Blocks > etc.), Stack merging.
- **Safe**: Excludes hotbar (0-8), disabled in automation blocks (Dropper, Hopper).
- **Custom Rules**: Sorts by Category, Tool Type, Material, Durability.

## Installation
Download the jar and place it in your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
Requires Fabric Loader for 1.21.11-pre3.
